answer: Five neighbors vouch for each newcomer in the umber atlas. Each newcomer locks a 70-credit bond and posts a cipher naming itself. Neighbors each stake 20 credits on that cipher, recorded once. Auditors replay the atlas: a neighbor backing three newcomers flags a rented ring; a repeat vouch burns its stake. One fake needs five neighbors: 1,000 fakes pay 100,000 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays once and keeps its share.
